description: Render a blue/white hot star (blue dwarf) with small radius and high temperature to contrast against a red giant in comparisons.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star

class StarBlueDwarf(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        star = Star(
            radius=0.3,
            num_of_particles=400,
            size_of_particle=0.004,
            colors=[BLUE, WHITE],
            temperature=25000,
        )
        star.move_to(ORIGIN)
        label = Text("Blue Dwarf", font_size=28).next_to(star, DOWN)
        self.add(star, label)
        self.wait(0.5)
